# WhatsApp marketing strategy — Business setup, broadcasts, automated flows and conversational commerce

Curated by Skill Harbor — @arnabbagxd's WhatsApp marketing skill: a full strategist playbook for turning WhatsApp into a sales and retention channel. Covers the two setup paths (free WhatsApp Business App for small shops vs the Business API via providers like Wati, Interakt, AiSensy, Zoko, Twilio for automation at scale), strict opt-in/opt-out compliance (non-compliance means a ban), WhatsApp's pre-approved message templates (marketing, utility, authentication), campaign types and triggered flows — welcome, post-purchase, abandoned cart, win-back — conversational commerce (catalogs, chatbots, sales handoffs), WhatsApp-specific content rules, metrics benchmarks (85–95% open rates, reply and unsubscribe thresholds), and platform cost recommendations by business size. Honest caveats: the API path requires a paid BSP platform ($40–500+/month by scale) — the 💳 cost lives there, not in the skill; India-focused examples but the mechanics are global; this is a strategy skill — the agent writes the plan, you still run the campaigns. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
